name: Verified Mechanisms
old_details: Verified Mechanisms is an independent, grant-funded research project (funded via Manifund) building a formally verified autoresearch pipeline for theoretical mechanistic interpretability, where multiple frontier LLM agents collaborate to generate theorems that are machine-checked in Lean 4. The pilot problem asks how many attention heads are needed to compute a Boolean function, and outputs include an open-source multi-agent orchestration harness and the xorformer theorem ledger repository. The team states it plans to onboard additional researchers over the coming months for multi-agent orchestration and mech interp work — there is no formal application form, but interested people can join the Discord or email hello@verifiedmechanisms.ai.

name: MIT AI Risk Initiative
old_details: The MIT AI Risk Initiative is an ongoing research project producing open data and frameworks for identifying, prioritizing, and managing AI risks. The site also publishes a blog with research updates, framework summaries, and project news, plus a newsletter.
